summary.text: Malcolm Teale, also known as Mac, is a Republican candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Lamoille-2 District (2 seats), in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside incumbent Richard Bailey (R) and against incumbent Daniel Noyes (D) and Jim Lipinski (D).
He also ran for the seat in 2022 and 2024, finishing third in the 2024 general election with 22.2 percent of the vote.
